problem.title: Signal window / prediction
problem.prompt:
Development exercise · scheduled review

An intake monitor reads [4,7,4,6,2,3,5,1]. A window of 2 consecutive readings moves one position at a time. Predict the largest window total. Explain what changes and what stays true when the window moves; describe a boundary worth checking. No full implementation is required.

Target scope: Implement fixed-size windows with correct enter/leave updates.
rubric: Explain update/state and a relevant boundary
